text.p: Toolex-Alpha NV said on Tuesday its 1996 net income had fallen to 76.2 million Swedish crowns from 90.4 million in the previous year.
Earlier this month, the company issued a warning that it expected 1996 revenues and earnings per share to be below previous expectations.
Toolex-Alpha develops and manufactures systems to produce optical discs. The company is Stockholm-based but its shares are listed in Amsterdam and on NASDAQ.

Toolex-Alpha said its 1996 sales had fallen to 573.6 million crowns from 598.7 million in 1995. Operating income after amortisation of goodwill totalled 125.3 million crowns, down from 148.9 million in 1995.

The company's interest income went up by 1.3 million crowns to 6.3 million and interest expenses fell by 19.4 million to 10.1 million. But other financial expenses rose by about five million crowns to nine million and gains from changes in currency rates fell by more than 10 million to 4.1 million crowns.
